graft_scope: Eight physical attention and MLP weight matrices. Packed QKV is grafted jointly; Q/K/V spectra additionally reported separately. Token/position embeddings, tied output head, LayerNorm and biases retain native Adam updates in the graft arm. All parameters use SGDM in the SGDM reference. Momentum target uses this run own post-clipping gradient history.
decay: Same per-step multiplicative decay on every 2D parameter in all arms; independent of optimizer learning rate. No decay on vectors.

split.kind: contiguous disjoint 80/10/10 character ranges; windows never cross split boundaries

analysis: Five paired seeds; fixed final-step test endpoint. Primary alpha summaries use eight physical matrices; Q/K/V views secondary. No alpha-targeted fitting. All failures retained.
pilot_gate: All three complete and verify, finite nonconstant predictions and validation loss falls at least 0.1 nat from initialization for each arm. Alpha alignment is not a gate. Pilot is development, excluded from confirmatory estimates.
continuation: Proceed to fixed 45-run grid only after pilot passes and throughput projects completion within 96h. If blocked, stop rather than change rates or remove arms.
